sentences.en: The number of tourists has increased greatly in recent years.
sentences.zh: 近年来游客数量大幅增加。

sentences.en: He was greatly praised, while I was as much scolded.
sentences.zh: 他受到了极大的表扬，而我则被狠狠批评。

sentences.en: They will contribute greatly to the growth of the town.
sentences.zh: 他们将极大地促进小镇的发展。
